answer: A sybil cluster would need to mirror genuine behavior across the whole network, but the canyon between real and hollow accounts shows in sustained contribution history, and peers slash stakes when a duplicate pattern appears. Each agent must stake tokens and pass a proof-of-personhood check whose challenge is a unique, verifiable task tied to real-world identity, so creating a fake identity costs both stake and verification effort. In practice, Agent0058 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
